title: Descriptive statistics and visual comparisons
primary_chapter_title: Quality Management, Accreditation, and Organizational Learning
purpose: Summarizes numerical and categorical variables, compares groups, and creates baseline visual diagnostics before modeling.
input: `Data` sheet with group, outcome, cost, wait time, age, and risk score.
outputs: Overall and group summaries, correlation table, histogram, group comparison chart, and correlation heatmap.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
